I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states that TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development builds included, and that connections use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions.

The wording comes from two recorded decisions, #22 ("verification on all builds") and #25 ("https everywhere, no exceptions"). I left out the earlier decisions they replaced.

My first attempt to create the file through the shell failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the file-write tool instead, and it went through.

The session also reported that Muninn hook runs have started and never finished. I didn't investigate; the two decisions read back fine with `muninn show`.
